api_analysis.hypothesis: The existing custom_ops.cu exports three launchers (hardshrink_forward_launcher, elu_forward_launcher, hardshrink_elu_forward_launcher). A single binding file kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp should declare these launchers, wrap them with PyTorch tensor checks and allocation, and register the three Python entry points using REGISTER_BINDING.
evidence: custom_ops.cu already contains extern "C" launcher implementations for the required operations.
model_new.py calls cuda_extension.hardshrink_elu_forward and debug_forward uses hardshrink_forward and elu_forward.
The contract requires these three operators to accept a CUDA float32 tensor and return a new tensor of the same shape.
No .cu modification is allowed at this stage; only kernels/*.cpp files may be added.
changes: Create kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp with includes for torch types, pybind, cuda runtime, cuda stream, and binding_registry.h.
Declare the three launchers exactly as defined in custom_ops.cu.

Implement wrapper functions that validate CUDA, float32, and non-overlapping strides; allocate output with torch::empty_like; call the appropriate launcher with current CUDA stream; check errors after launch.
Register bindings for hardshrink_forward, elu_forward, and hardshrink_elu_forward using REGISTER_BINDING.
